## pearse.dev social scheduler
See automation/n8n/README.md in the pearse.dev repository.

The Decide and Record result nodes embed automation/n8n/select.mjs (the tested reference). Edit select.mjs first, then paste.

DRY_RUN is on unless the variable is exactly `false`.

Bluesky and Mastodon get the short copy when BLUESKY_CREDENTIAL / MASTODON_CREDENTIAL (+ MASTODON_INSTANCE_URL) are set; otherwise they are skipped.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ repo: ($json.body || {}).did || '', collection: 'app.bsky.feed.post', record: $('Decide').all().map((i) => i.json).find((j) => j.action === 'post_bluesky').record }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
// Tags the createRecord response so Record result knows which network answered.
return $input.all().map((i) => ({ json: { ...i.json, network: 'bluesky' } }));

// Tags the statuses response so Record result knows which network answered.
return $input.all().map((i) => ({ json: { ...i.json, network: 'mastodon' } }));
